convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iIchimoku, custom oscillator from Ichimoku components). Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot position sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic.

indicators.name: Ichimoku Oscillator
indicators.derived_period: Derived from Ichimoku: Tenkan-Kijun difference as oscillator histogram

derived_values.name: Adjusted SL points
derived_values.formula: StopLoss * PoinT (where PoinT = _Point adjusted for 5-digit brokers: if _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 then _Point*10 else _Point)

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: The EA computes a custom Ichimoku Oscillator as the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen. This oscillator crossing zero is the primary signal. Price position relative to the Ichimoku cloud (Senkou Span A and B) acts as a trend filter. The digit adjustment logic multiplies SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers. The EA checks IsNewBar to only evaluate signals once per completed bar. Position gate ensures only one position is open at a time - opposite signals close existing position before entering new one.
python_conversion_notes: Key conversion considerations: 1) The Ichimoku oscillator is simply Tenkan minus Kijun from the built-in iIchimoku - straightforward to replicate using any Ichimoku library. 2) Digit adjustment: the PoinT variable adjusts _Point by x10 for 5-digit brokers - in Python this translates to checking if price_decimals >= 5 and multiplying pip values accordingly. 3) New bar detection uses static datetime comparison - implement with bar timestamp tracking. 4) Signal logic uses completed bar values (shift=1 for previous bar, shift=2 for bar before that) for crossover detection. 5) The cloud filter compares current price to Senkou Span A and B. 6) Position check uses PositionSelect by symbol - only one position at a time.
